title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
title_zh: VeriFine：面向具身推理自提升的验证扩展

paragraphs.en: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.

paragraphs.en: Verification is central to self-improvement: it supplies feedback for policy optimization and determines which training examples are worth learning from ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Kumar et al., 2026 ) . However, policy improvement also changes the judge demands, and the rapid progress of foundation models has increasingly outpaced the ability to evaluate them reliably ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Most existing approaches rely on a static verification judge, whose capability can quickly become a bottleneck as the policy improves ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Once the policy approaches or exceeds the judge’s effective verification boundary, the resulting feedback can become increasingly inaccurate, leading to reward hacking, distribution shift, and even performance degradation ( Khalaf et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, static training data also become progressively less informative ( Koh et al., 2026 ) for further improvement with verification: as previous scenarios are solved, the training distribution becomes dominated by well-solved samples, leaving limited learning signal. This raises a central question for verification: How can verification be scaled so that the judge, training curriculum, and policy co-evolve to continuously push the performance frontier?
paragraphs.zh: 验证在自我提升中占据核心地位：它为策略优化提供反馈，并决定哪些训练示例值得学习（Guo 等，2025；Kumar 等，2026）。然而，策略改进也会改变评估者的需求，而基础模型的高速发展已日益超出可靠评估它们的能力（Gu 等，2026；Li 等，2025）。大多数现有方法都依赖静态的验证评估者，其能力会随着策略的改进而迅速成为瓶颈（Wang 等，2026a）。一旦策略接近或超过评估者的有效验证边界，所产生的反馈就可能变得越来越不准确，从而导致奖励欺骗、分布偏移甚至性能下降（Khalaf 等，2026）。与此同时，静态训练数据在结合验证进行进一步改进时，其信息含量也会逐渐降低（Koh 等，2026）：随着先前场景被解决，训练分布将主要由已妥善解决的样本主导，从而留下有限的学习信号。这引出了验证领域的一个核心问题：如何扩展验证能力，使评估者、训练课程和策略能够协同进化，以持续推动性能边界的突破？

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in agentic systems and autoresearch ( Anthropic, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025 ) offer a natural framework to realize this co-evolution task by coordinating specialized skills and analyzing failures during iterative optimization. In this work, we study scaling verification within an agentic framework for embodied reasoning, using driving and robot navigation as representative tasks. Unlike conventional language tasks, embodied agents require reasoning in the physical world and handle spatial grounding, temporal understanding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) , making reliable verification challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统和自动研究领域的最新进展（Anthropic，2025；OpenAI，2025）为通过协调专业技能并在迭代优化过程中分析失败来实现这一协同进化任务提供了天然框架。在本研究中，我们探索了具身推理智能体框架内的扩展性验证问题，并以驾驶和机器人导航作为代表性任务。与传统的语言任务不同，具身智能体需要在物理世界中进行推理，并处理空间定位、时间理解、因果推理和安全感知决策等问题（Zhang 等人，2025c），这使得可靠的验证变得极具挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Prior work on verification for embodied reasoning focuses on action quality or task completion ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , while evaluating free-form embodied reasoning remains underexplored. Existing reasoning evaluators often rely on constrained question-answering formats and costly human-annotated references ( Sima et al., 2024 ) ; even LingoJudge ( Marcu et al., 2024 ) only compares against human reasoning without using visual information. Such reference-based evaluation is difficult to scale and sensitive to annotation noise. In contrast, a reference-free judge can assess reasoning directly from physical context, enabling scalable verification and adaptive data selection that filters well-solved scenarios and prioritizes emerging policy failures.
paragraphs.zh: 关于具身推理验证的早期研究主要集中在动作质量或任务完成度上（Sun et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026a），而对自由形式的具身推理进行评估则仍属未充分探索的领域。现有的推理评估方法通常依赖受限的问题回答格式以及成本高昂的人工标注参考数据（Sima et al., 2024）；即便是 LingoJudge（Marcu et al., 2024），也仅通过与人类推理结果进行比较，而未使用视觉信息。这种基于参考数据的评估方式难以扩展，且对标注噪声十分敏感。相比之下，一种无需参考数据的评判方法可以直接从物理环境中评估推理过程，从而实现可扩展的验证和自适应的数据选择，既能过滤掉已妥善解决的场景，又能优先关注新出现的策略失效情况。

paragraphs.en: Verification assesses the quality or correctness of candidate outputs and provides feedback for selection, monitoring, and policy optimization ( Kwok et al., 2026a ) . At inference time, verification can directly enable test-time scaling with a verifier by allocating additional compute to candidate generation, search, and ranking ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025d ) , while the fine-grained critics with the verifier can diagnose errors and guide iterative revision or recovery ( Gou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2026 ) . During training, verification within judges can provide objectives for policy optimization ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) , while also filtering noisy samples and prioritizing high-value data to concentrate learning on unresolved failures ( Zang et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . Existing work has begun to construct judge benchmarks ( Tan et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) and explore judge improvement ( Saha et al., 2025 ; Whitehouse et al., 2026 ) . However, existing work focuses on the improvement of the individual roles of verification ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , but does not scale verification to close feedback loops among adaptive data selection, policy optimization, judge evolution, and selective human calibration, thereby continuously pushing the performance frontier.
paragraphs.zh: 验证用于评估候选输出的质量或正确性，并为选择、监控和策略优化提供反馈（Kwok 等，2026a）。在推理阶段，验证可以通过分配额外的计算资源给候选生成、搜索和排序，直接借助验证器实现测试时的扩展（Snell 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025d）；同时，与验证器配合使用的细粒度批评者能够诊断错误，并指导迭代修订或恢复（Gou 等，2024；Xie 等，2025；Wan 等，2026）。在训练阶段，判断器内部的验证可以为策略优化提供目标（Yuan 等，2024；Liu 等，2025a；Zhang 等，2025a），同时还能过滤噪声样本并优先处理高价值数据，从而将学习集中在尚未解决的失败案例上（Zang 等，2025；Cui 等，2025）。现有研究已开始构建判断器基准（Tan 等，2025b；Zhou 等，2025），并探索如何改进判断器（Saha 等，2025；Whitehouse 等，2026）。然而，现有工作主要集中在验证各个独立角色的改进上（Singh 等，2026），但尚未将验证扩展至自适应数据选择、策略优化、判断器演进和选择性人类校准之间的闭环反馈中，从而持续推动性能边界的突破。

paragraphs.en: Agent-driven self-improvement through hypothesis formation, experimentation, and iterative refinement has emerged as a prominent paradigm, particularly in goal-oriented autoresearch ( Schmidgall et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . As self-improvement continuously strengthens the policy model, its verifier must adapt to the resulting capability and distribution shifts ( Ding et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) . Recent work has begun to consider the policy and judge improvement together ( Zhou et al., 2026a ; Zha et al., 2026 ) or dynamically adapt the judge to policy behavior ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . Rubric-based judges have also gained increasing attention because structured criteria provide fine-grained and more accurate judgment beyond a single final score ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, autonomous self-improvement eventually encounters bottlenecks when the verifier approaches its effective limit or self-generated feedback becomes unreliable ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . At this stage, a small amount of selectively acquired human guidance can become necessary to recalibrate the judge ( Dwaracherla et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . We connect this adaptation to curriculum construction: emerging policy failures guide selective human–agent calibration, and the resulting judge refinements shape subsequent data selection and policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 通过假设构建、实验和迭代优化实现的智能体驱动型自我提升已成为一种重要的范式，尤其是在目标导向的自动研究中（Schmidgall 等，2025；Chen 等，2026b）。随着自我提升持续增强策略模型，其验证器必须适应由此产生的能力和分布变化（Ding 等，2026；Xu 等，2026b）。近期的研究开始将策略和评判者的改进结合起来考虑（Zhou 等，2026a；Zha 等，2026），或动态调整评判者以适应策略行为（Wang 等，2026a；Xu 等，2026a）。基于评分标准的评判者也日益受到关注，因为结构化的标准能够提供比单一最终分数更精细、更准确的判断（Gunjal 等，2026；Li 等，2026；Liu 等，2026）。然而，当验证器接近其有效极限或自我生成的反馈变得不可靠时，自主自我提升最终会遇到瓶颈（Huang 等，2024）。在此阶段，少量经过选择性获取的人类指导可能变得必要，以重新校准评判者（Dwaracherla 等，2024；Wang 等，2026b）。我们将这种适应性与课程构建联系起来：新出现的策略失败会引导选择性的“人类–智能体”校准，而由此产生的评判者优化则会塑造后续的数据选择和策略优化。

paragraphs.en: Embodied reasoning requires spatial grounding, temporal understanding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making ( Xiong et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , making reliable verification challenging. Recent work on driving reasoning has introduced structured reasoning datasets ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026b ) and demonstrated the benefits of reasoning for scene understanding ( Nie et al., 2024 ; Coscoy et al., 2026 ) , generalization ( Peng et al., 2026 ; Gerstenecker et al., 2026 ) , and planning ( Zhou et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026c ) . However, existing evaluators largely use constrained question-answering formats with costly human references ( Marcu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , while driving-specific judges mainly assess trajectory quality ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . In robotics, recent judge models focus on evaluating task progress or completion from video ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) and action-instruction alignment ( Kwok et al., 2026b ) rather than on high-level free-form reasoning itself. Direct video-grounded verification of free-form embodied reasoning without costly human-annotation references remains underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 具身推理需要空间锚定、时间理解、因果推理和安全感知的决策能力（Xiong 等，2026；Zhang 等，2025b；Liu 等，2025b；Lee 等，2026），这使得可靠的验证变得具有挑战性。近期关于驾驶推理的研究引入了结构化推理数据集（Wang 等，2025；Huang 等，2026b），并证明了推理在场景理解（Nie 等，2024；Coscoy 等，2026）、泛化能力（Peng 等，2026；Gerstenecker 等，2026）和规划（Zhou 等，2026b；Zhou 等，2026c）方面的优势。然而，现有的评估方法大多采用受约束的问答格式，并依赖成本高昂的人工参考（Marcu 等，2024；Wang 等，2024），而针对驾驶场景的专用评判模型则主要评估轨迹质量（Sun 等，2026）。在机器人领域，近期的评判模型更关注通过视频评估任务进展或完成情况（Ma 等，2025；Tan 等，2025a；Huang 等，2026a；Liang 等，2026；Luo 等，2026），以及动作与指令的一致性（Kwok 等，2026b），而非对高层自由形式推理本身进行评估。无需昂贵人工标注参考、直接基于视频对自由形式具身推理进行验证的方法仍尚未得到充分探索。

paragraphs.en: The judge serves as the verification substrate and a shared interface to connect policy optimization, curriculum construction, and human guidance. Unlike a reference-based judge J ϕ ​ ( y ^ i , y i ref ) J_{\phi}(\hat{y}_{i},y_{i}^{\mathrm{ref}}) , our judge evaluates the outputs directly from the physical context without human-annotated reasoning:
paragraphs.zh: 裁判者充当验证基础，同时也是连接策略优化、课程构建和人类指导的共享接口。与基于参考的裁判者 J ϕ ​ ( y ^ i , y i ref ) J_{\phi}(\hat{y}_{i},y_{i}^{\mathrm{ref}}) 不同，我们的裁判者直接从物理上下文中评估输出，而无需依赖人类标注的推理过程：

paragraphs.en: where s i s_{i} is the overall quality score for the sample i i , 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} are the structured diagnostic scores, and e i e_{i} is an optional evaluation explanation. We name the judge VeriFine-Judge in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，s i s_{i} 是样本 i i 的整体质量分数，𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} 是结构化诊断分数，而 e i e_{i} 是一个可选的评价解释。在本文中，我们将该评判器命名为 VeriFine-Judge。

paragraphs.en: To reliably evaluate free-form reasoning, we instantiate the judge with a frontier vision-language model (VLM) and an explicit rubric that produces structured diagnostic scores 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} rather than a single opaque score. However, frontier VLMs are too costly and slow during large-scale policy optimization such as in reinforcement fine-tuning. We therefore adopt a teacher–student design: a frontier VLM serves as the teacher, whose rubric is coactively calibrated with humans as described in Section 3.4.2 , and its evaluation capability is then distilled into a compact VLM student to balance verification quality with efficiency. More implementation details are provided in Section A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了可靠地评估自由形式推理，我们将评判器具体化为一个前沿视觉-语言模型（VLM）和一个明确的评分标准，该标准会生成结构化的诊断分数 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i}，而非单一的不透明分数。然而，在强化微调等大规模策略优化过程中，前沿 VLM 的成本过高且速度过慢。因此，我们采用了一种教师-学生设计：一个前沿 VLM 担任教师角色，其评分标准会按照第 3.4.2 节所述的方式与人类共同校准；随后，将其评估能力蒸馏到一个紧凑的 VLM 学生模型中，以在验证质量与效率之间取得平衡。更多实现细节见第 A.2 节。

paragraphs.en: The rubric organizes embodied reasoning into two groups of criteria: Action and Component . Taking driving as an example, Action evaluates instruction consistency and safety, while Component evaluates visual grounding, coverage of behavior-relevant scene elements, and their causal relationship to the proposed action. Task-specific dimensions and score aggregation are detailed in Section A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 该评分标准将具身推理分为两组标准：行动与组件。以驾驶为例，行动标准评估指令的一致性与安全性，而组件标准则评估视觉锚定、行为相关场景元素的覆盖范围，以及这些元素与所提议行动之间的因果关系。任务特定的维度与分数汇总详见第 A.2 节。

paragraphs.en: This loop converts judge-identified failure patterns into training decisions through multiple rounds of autonomous data selection, policy optimization, and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 该循环通过多轮自主数据选择、策略优化和评估，将法官识别出的失败模式转化为训练决策。

A scenario that exposes a policy weakness can be valuable for learning, while an incorrect response to that scenario is unsuitable as a supervised demonstration. The curriculum is revisited as policy weaknesses and judge change, allowing a revised judge to recover useful supervision or exclude examples that were previously misjudged.

Moreover, judge refinement deliberately retains both positive and negative outputs. The low-scoring cases are important for defining the judge’s decision boundary and calibrating its responses to policy errors.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦激活，该智能体便会构建当前的法官评估集 ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t}，其中包含评估结果不确定、不一致且影响重大的案例。重要的是，ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} 是由新更新的策略 π θ t + 1 \pi_{\theta_{t+1}} 生成的输出构建而成的。它能够追踪该策略当前的失效模式。此外，法官优化过程会刻意保留正向和负向的输出。得分较低的案例对于界定法官的决策边界以及校准其对策略错误的响应至关重要。

paragraphs.en: The Judge Improvement Loop receives the current failure-pattern analysis and the selected evaluation set ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} . The agent uses them to update a cumulative judge evaluation set:
paragraphs.zh: 法官改进循环接收当前的失败模式分析以及选定的评估集 ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t}。智能体利用这些信息来更新累积的法官评估集：

paragraphs.en: Its cumulative construction preserves cases from previous iterations, preventing new refinements from degrading previously acquired verification capabilities. During initial judge construction, the same procedure is based on the base policy π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} . Further details are provided in Section A.3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 其累积构建保留了先前迭代中的案例，防止新的优化损害之前获得的验证能力。在初始判官构建过程中，相同的过程基于基础策略 π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} 。更多细节请参见第 A.3.1 节。

paragraphs.en: Human experts first provide a coarse calibration of the judge scores on 𝒥 t \mathcal{J}_{t} by inspecting the physical context and candidate outputs. Then, the agent launches an autonomous process that iteratively proposes, evaluates, and selects revisions to the rubric. When alignment with the current human calibration plateaus, the agent presents the disputed cases together with its structured diagnostic scores and evaluation explanations. Human experts may confirm the evaluation, correct individual rubric dimensions, clarify underspecified criteria, or even revise their previous judge scores annotation in evaluation set. Human judgments are not treated as infallible ground truth. Instead, the agent and human experts repeatedly expose disagreements and refine their interpretations until no further alignment gain can be achieved, converging toward the shared latent rubric of embodied reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，人类专家通过检查物理上下文和候选输出，对 𝒥 t \mathcal{J}_{t} 上的评分员分数进行粗略校准。随后，智能体启动一个自主流程，迭代地提出、评估并选择评分标准的修订方案。当与当前人类校准结果的契合度趋于平稳时，智能体会将存在争议的案例与其结构化的诊断评分和评估解释一并呈现。人类专家可以确认评估结果、修正单个评分标准维度、澄清表述不清的标准，甚至修改其在评估集中先前对评分员的分数标注。人类的判断并不会被视为无误的基准事实。相反，智能体与人类专家会反复揭示分歧并完善各自的解读，直到无法进一步实现校准提升，最终收敛于一个共享的、具身推理的潜在评分标准。

paragraphs.en: We conduct three self-improvement rounds on driving reasoning. Unless otherwise specified, the following settings refer to this task; detailed navigation settings are provided in the appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对驾驶推理进行了三轮自我提升。除非另有说明，以下设置均指此任务；详细的导航设置见附录。

paragraphs.en: Driving Reasoning Data. Our main experiments use a large-scale internal driving-reasoning dataset covering 2 million clips of human driving across 25 countries, with synchronized multi-view videos, trajectories, and free-form reasoning. We construct a fixed anchor policy evaluation set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} of 2,134 samples and an independent policy test set 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} of 2,772 samples. Those anchor sets are manually quality-checked to ensure reliable annotations and broad coverage of scenario types. Judge calibration uses incrementally selected nominal and challenging scenarios. Across the first two judge-improvement rounds, the selected judge evaluation subsets ℋ 1 \mathcal{H}_{1} and ℋ 2 \mathcal{H}_{2} are constructed, containing 433 normal and 179 challenging driving scenarios. The corresponding judge test sets are ℋ 1 test \mathcal{H}_{1}^{\mathrm{test}} and ℋ 2 test \mathcal{H}_{2}^{\mathrm{test}} with 514 and 218 scenarios. The final judge test set 𝒥 test \mathcal{J}^{\mathrm{test}} is their union. Test labels are frozen and excluded from rubric refinement. Details are provided in Section A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶推理数据。我们的主要实验使用一个大规模的内部驾驶推理数据集，该数据集涵盖了来自25个国家的200万条人类驾驶片段，并同步提供了多视角视频、轨迹和自由形式的推理文本。我们构建了一个包含2,134个样本的固定锚点策略评估集 𝒫 \mathcal{P}，以及一个包含2,772个样本的独立策略测试集 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}}。这些锚点数据集经过人工质量检查，以确保标注的可靠性和场景类型的广泛覆盖。裁判校准则使用逐步选择的常规和复杂场景。在最初的两轮裁判改进中，分别构建了选定的裁判评估子集 ℋ 1 \mathcal{H}_{1} 和 ℋ 2 \mathcal{H}_{2}，其中包含433个常规驾驶场景和179个复杂驾驶场景。对应的裁判测试集为 ℋ 1 test \mathcal{H}_{1}^{\mathrm{test}} 和 ℋ 2 test \mathcal{H}_{2}^{\mathrm{test}}，分别包含514个和218个场景。最终的裁判测试集 𝒥 test \mathcal{J}^{\mathrm{test}} 是这两个测试集的并集。测试标签被固定，且未纳入评分标准优化过程。详细信息请参见第A.3节。

paragraphs.en: Policy and Judge Models. We initialize the driving policy of the Alpamayo 1.5 8B ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) model. Policy optimization is performed using GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) with the overall reference-free judge score as the reward. The judge follows the teacher–student design introduced in Section 3.2 . We use Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) as the base model for the rubric teacher and distill its evaluation capability into a compact model after coactive calibration. The student model is built on a Qwen3-VL 2B backbone ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , and we pretrain the backbone to have a better vision encoder on our internal driving dataset with the VLA planning task. More details of the policy and judge model are provided in Section A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 策略模型与评判模型。我们初始化了 Alpamayo 1.5 8B（NVIDIA，2026）模型的驾驶策略。策略优化采用 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）方法，并以整体无参考的评判分数作为奖励。评判模型遵循第 3.2 节中介绍的“教师-学生”设计。我们将 Claude Opus 5（Anthropic，2026）用作评分标准教师的基线模型，并通过协同校准将其评估能力蒸馏到一个紧凑型模型中。学生模型基于 Qwen3-VL 2B 主干网络（Bai 等人，2025），我们利用 VLA 规划任务，在内部驾驶数据集上对该主干网络进行预训练，以增强其视觉编码能力。关于策略模型和评判模型的更多细节，请参见第 A.2 节。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Metrics. All policies are evaluated on 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} using the fixed reference-based evaluator, VeriFine-Judge-RB. We additionally report scores from the same final reference-free judge for all policies. Policy metrics include reasoning scores on a 0–100 scale, ADE, and minADE 6 \mathrm{minADE}_{6} . Judge quality is measured by Pearson correlation r r and MAE against human scores, with MAE normalized to a 0–1 scale. More details are in Section A.4 . Besides, on the judge test set, VeriFine-Judge-RB achieves r r 0.82, compared with 0.65 for the SOTA method LingoJudge, as shown in Figure 3 . This provides empirical support for the fixed evaluator used to compare policies across rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。所有策略均使用固定的基于参考的评估器 VeriFine-Judge-RB 在 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} 上进行评估。此外，我们还报告了同一最终无参考评判器对所有策略的得分。策略评估指标包括 0–100 分制的推理得分、ADE 和 minADE 6 \mathrm{minADE}_{6}。评判器的质量通过与人评分相比的皮尔逊相关系数 r 和 MAE 来衡量，其中 MAE 已归一化到 0–1 的尺度。更多细节见第 A.4 节。此外，在评判器测试集上，VeriFine-Judge-RB 实现的 r 为 0.82，而 SOTA 方法 LingoJudge 的 r 为 0.65，如图 3 所示。这为跨轮次比较策略时使用的固定评估器提供了经验支持。

paragraphs.en: Judge–Policy Co-Evolution (Q1). Figure 1 summarizes the coupled improvement process in driving reasoning task, whose focus progresses from nominal driving scenarios to challenging failures and then to balanced refinement. Across three rounds, the policy reasoning score increases from 60.56 to 71.61 under the fixed reference-based evaluator, an 18.2% relative improvement over the base policy. Meanwhile, student judge–human correlation reaches 0.82 on the final judge test set, indicating strong alignment after coactive calibration. These results reveal a complementary cycle: policy improvement exposes new verification limitations, while judge refinement restores reliable supervision for further policy improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 策略–评判者协同进化（Q1）。图1总结了推理任务中耦合的改进过程，其重点逐步从常规驾驶场景转向具有挑战性的失败情况，再转向均衡的优化。在三轮迭代中，基于固定参考评估器的策略推理得分从60.56提升至71.61，相较于基础策略实现了18.2%的相对改进。与此同时，学生评判者与人类的关联度在最终评判者测试集上达到了0.82，表明经过协同校准后实现了高度一致。这些结果揭示了一个互补的循环：策略改进暴露出新的验证局限性，而评判者的优化则恢复了可靠的监督机制，从而支持进一步的策略提升。

paragraphs.en: Policy Improvement Loop (Q2). Table 1 examines the use of judges for curriculum construction and policy optimization. With VeriFine-Judge-RB held fixed as the reward, judge-guided selection improves the reasoning score from 64.03 to 67.70 over random selection, demonstrating the value of directing training toward selected examples. The first reference-free round reaches 67.30, comparable to the strongest reference-based configuration (67.70) without any costly annotation reliance during inference. Under the same policy-training budget, subsequent rounds reach 70.59 and 71.61, with R3 exceeding the strongest reference-based baseline by 5.8%. The final policy also achieves the lowest ADE, even without any action reward in training. With each round’s reward judge held fixed, judge-guided selection improves RB performance over random selection by 4.5–14.6% (Appendix Table 2 ). These results demonstrate a stronger policy yield from the evolved curriculum and judge in the self-improvement loop.
paragraphs.zh: 策略改进循环（Q2）。表1研究了在课程构建和策略优化中使用判定的情况。在将 VeriFine-Judge-RB 固定为奖励的情况下，由判定引导的选择相较于随机选择，将推理分数从 64.03 提升至 67.70，这表明将训练方向聚焦于选定示例具有显著价值。第一轮无参考配置达到了 67.30，与最强的参考依赖配置（67.70）相当，且在整个推理过程中无需依赖任何成本高昂的标注。在相同的策略训练预算下，后续几轮分别达到了 70.59 和 71.61，其中 R3 比最强的参考依赖基线高出 5.8%。最终策略还实现了最低的 ADE，尽管在训练过程中完全没有使用任何动作奖励。在每轮中固定奖励判定的情况下，由判定引导的选择使 RB 的性能相较于随机选择提升了 4.5%–14.6%（附录表2）。这些结果表明，通过自改进循环演化出的课程和判定能够产生更强大的策略。

paragraphs.en: Using the final VeriFine-Judge as a fixed reference-free evaluator yields a similar improvement trend across rounds, with a relative gain of 22.2% compared with 18.2% under a reference-based evaluator, supporting its effectiveness as an evaluation metric. The embodied decisions admit multiple plausible futures; the reference-free judge can credit grounded, safe alternatives that differ from the recorded behavior, yielding a more permissive assessment without requiring reference agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 将最终的 VeriFine-Judge 用作固定的无参考评估器，在各轮测试中均呈现出相似的提升趋势：与基于参考的评估器相比，其相对增益为 22.2%，而后者为 18.2%，这证明了其作为评估指标的有效性。具身决策允许存在多种合理的可能性；无参考评估器能够认可那些与记录行为不同但具有现实依据且安全的替代方案，从而在不要求与参考一致的情况下，实现更为宽松的评估。

paragraphs.en: Judge Improvement Loop (Q2). Figure 3 (a,b) shows progressively stronger judge–human alignment: teacher correlation increases from 0.55 to 0.85, while MAE decreases from 0.25 to 0.13. The final student achieves r = 0.82 r=0.82 and MAE = 0.17 =0.17 , comparable to the reference-based judge VeriFine-Judge-RB (0.82/0.16) and better than LingoJudge (0.65/0.23) without requiring reference reasoning. Moreover, with the Opus 5 backbone held fixed, coactive calibration improves correlation from 0.67 to 0.85 (Appendix Figure 5 ), demonstrating gains from refinement beyond backbone capability. Student architecture ablations and latency performance are reported in Appendix Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 法官改进循环（Q2）。图3（a、b）显示了法官与人类的一致性逐步增强：教师相关性从0.55提升至0.85，而MAE则从0.25降至0.13。最终的学生模型实现了r = 0.82 r=0.82和MAE = 0.17 =0.17，与基于参考的法官VeriFine-Judge-RB（0.82/0.16）相当，且优于LingoJudge（0.65/0.23），同时无需依赖参考推理。此外，在固定Opus 5骨干模型的前提下，协同校准将相关性从0.67提升至0.85（附录图5），表明通过优化可超越骨干模型本身的能力。学生模型架构的消融实验及延迟性能报告见附录表3。

paragraphs.en: The failure-specific results reveal how the loop expands the verification boundary. As policy failure analysis shifts attention toward challenging scenarios, the loop identifies errors in the current judge’s assessments and targets them through coactive calibration. Our R1 student achieves r = 0.72 r=0.72 on the first-round test subset but only r = 0.07 r=0.07 on the later challenging subset; refinement raises correlation on the latter to r = 0.74 r=0.74 in R2 (Appendix Figure 6 ). R3 then targets remaining errors across the accumulated scenarios without adding a new test subset. Through this diagnosis–calibration cycle, newly exposed verification errors become reusable judge refinements that inform subsequent curriculum construction and policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 针对特定失败的实验结果揭示了该循环如何扩展验证边界。随着策略失败分析将注意力转向更具挑战性的场景，该循环能够识别当前评判者评估中的错误，并通过协同校准加以修正。我们的 R1 学生在第一轮测试子集上实现了 r = 0.72 r=0.72 的相关性，但在后续更具挑战性的子集上仅为 r = 0.07 r=0.07；经过优化后，R2 中后者的相关性提升至 r = 0.74 r=0.74（附录图 6）。随后，R3 针对已积累场景中的剩余错误进行修正，而无需添加新的测试子集。通过这种诊断–校准循环，新暴露的验证错误可转化为可重复使用的评判者优化手段，从而指导后续课程构建与策略优化。

paragraphs.en: To assess verification beyond the training loop, a separate policy generates six reasoning–action candidates for each of 401 independent scenarios. All judges select from the same candidate pool as the sampling budget increases from one to six. Figure 3 (c) compares the R2 and R3 judges with random selection, LingoJudge, VeriFine-Judge-RB, and a human-oracle upper bound.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估训练循环之外的验证效果，一个独立的策略为401个独立场景中的每个场景生成六个推理–行动候选方案。随着采样预算从1增加到6，所有评判者均从同一候选方案池中进行选择。图3(c)将R2和R3评判者与随机选择、LingoJudge、VeriFine-Judge-RB以及人类判官这一上限进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: At a budget of six candidates, our final judge selects outputs with a human-rated reasoning score of 78.6, outperforming the R2 judge and LingoJudge while performing comparably to VeriFine-Judge-RB. Because candidate generation is held fixed, the gains reflect improved selection rather than a stronger generating policy. These results demonstrate effective generalization of the evolved judge.
paragraphs.zh: 在六个候选智能体的预算下，我们的最终评判器选出了人类评分为 78.6 的推理得分输出，其表现优于 R2 评判器和 LingoJudge，同时与 VeriFine-Judge-RB 的表现相当。由于候选生成过程保持不变，这些提升反映了选择能力的增强，而非生成策略的强化。这些结果证明了演化出的评判器具有有效的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Cross-Task Self-Improvement (Q4). Figure 4 shows improvements in both policy reasoning and judge alignment as the optimization focus shifts from nominal scenarios toward exploration efficiency. The final policy reasoning score improves by 14% from 68.09 to 77.59, while the final judge–human correlation approaches 0.85. The qualitative example in Figure 4 and Figure 1 illustrates corrected movement, goal understanding, and stopping decisions after our self-improvement framework. These results extend the role of evolving verification beyond reward-based optimization: it can also support self-improvement by refining the supervision selected for SFT. Moreover, the resumed policy gains after judge refinement mirror the driving results, demonstrating that the co-evolution framework transfers across embodied-reasoning tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 跨任务自我改进（Q4）。图4显示，随着优化重点从名义场景转向探索效率，策略推理和判断对齐均得到了提升。最终的策略推理分数从68.09提高了14%，达到77.59，而最终的判断–人类相关性接近0.85。图4和图1中的定性示例展示了我们的自我改进框架之后，运动、目标理解和停止决策均得到了修正。这些结果将演化验证的作用扩展到了奖励优化之外：它还可以通过优化SFT所选的监督机制来支持自我改进。此外，在判断优化之后策略性能的再次提升与驱动结果相呼应，表明该协同进化框架可以在具身推理任务中实现迁移。

Across backbones, rubric-based judging consistently outperforms judging without an explicit rubric, demonstrating the importance of structured evaluation criteria. Coactive calibration further substantially improves the Opus 5 judge ( 2 ) over its pre-calibration counterpart, showing that the gain arises not only from a strong backbone but also from iterative judge refinement.

paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了 Opus 5，因为在主要实验进行期间，它是我们评估套件中可用的最强基础模型。GPT-6 (39) 和 Gemini 3.8 (11) 是在这项工作接近完成时发布的，因此被后续加入；但两者相较于经过校准的 Opus 5 评判模型，均未展现出明显的改进。

paragraphs.en: Our reference-free judge evaluates candidate reasoning directly from the observable physical context, without requiring human annotation for reasoning during inference. Figure 7 illustrates the teacher–student architecture. The teacher combines a frontier VLM with an explicit embodied-reasoning rubric. The rubric subscores and explanations support failure diagnosis and coactive calibration. Then, its structured evaluations are distilled into a compact VLM student for large-scale reward computation, curriculum construction, and test-time scaling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的无参考评判器直接从可观察的物理上下文中评估候选推理过程，无需在推理阶段依赖人工标注。图 7 展示了教师–学生架构。该架构中的教师模型结合了一种前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）与一套显式的具身推理评分标准。该评分标准提供的子分数和解释有助于故障诊断与协同校准。随后，其结构化评估结果会被提炼为一个紧凑的 VLM 学生模型，用于大规模奖励计算、课程构建以及测试时的扩展应用。

paragraphs.en: We use Claude Opus 5 ( 2 ) as the teacher model. Its input contains three uniformly sampled history frames from the camera streams, ego-state information, the driving or robot navigation instructions, and the candidate policy output. The teacher returns multiple rubric scores (across two main dimensions: Action and Component ), the coherence diagnostic, an overall score, and a concise explanation in a structured, constrained format.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Claude Opus 5 (2) 作为教师模型。其输入包含从摄像头流中均匀采样的三个历史帧、自我状态信息、驾驶或机器人导航指令，以及候选策略输出。教师模型会返回多个评分标准分数（涵盖两个主要维度：动作和组件）、连贯性诊断结果、一个总体得分，以及以结构化且受约束的格式提供的简明解释。

paragraphs.en: The first two Action dimensions evaluate whether the proposed action is consistent with the driving instruction and safe under the observed scene. The remaining dimensions of Component evaluate whether the reasoning grounds its claims in visible evidence, identifies all behavior-relevant scene components, and correctly explains their causal relationship to the proposed action. We additionally use reasoning coherence as a diagnostic dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 前两个“动作”维度用于评估所提议的动作是否与驾驶指令一致，以及在当前观察到的场景中是否安全。“组件”的其他维度则用于评估其推理过程是否以可见的证据为基础，是否识别出了所有与行为相关的场景组件，以及是否正确地解释了这些组件与所提议动作之间的因果关系。此外，我们还使用“推理连贯性”作为一个诊断维度。

paragraphs.en: The action-match gate removes action credit when the proposed action is inconsistent with the driving instruction, while the separate component term preserves credit for correctly grounded scene understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 动作匹配门会在所提议的动作与驾驶指令不一致时移除动作信用，而独立的组件项则会保留对场景正确理解所获得的信用。

paragraphs.en: Robot Navigation Reasoning Rubric. Navigation retains the Action and Component structure but evaluates goal-directed movement rather than action matching with driving instructions. The horizon of robot navigation instruction is longer than driving reasoning task, because it defines the final goal of the robot navigation. The judge predicts four binary rubric dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 机器人导航推理评分标准。导航任务保留了“动作”和“组件”的结构，但评估的是以目标为导向的移动，而非与驾驶指令的动作匹配程度。机器人导航指令的时间跨度比驾驶推理任务更长，因为它定义了机器人导航的最终目标。裁判将预测四个二元评分维度：

paragraphs.en: Action safety assesses whether the proposed movement has sufficient clearance under the observed geometry without potential collision. Goal consistency assesses efficient progress toward the instructed destination, including purposeful exploration before target localization and appropriate stopping upon arrival. Naming the correct target does not compensate for an incorrect movement direction or a premature stop.
paragraphs.zh: 动作安全性评估所提议的移动是否在观测到的几何结构下具有足够的空间，且不会发生潜在碰撞。目标一致性评估向指定目的地的高效推进过程，包括在定位目标前进行有目的的探索，以及到达后适时停止。正确命名目标并不能弥补移动方向错误或过早停止的问题。

paragraphs.en: The Component dimensions retain visual grounding and action–component causation, without a separate completeness score:
paragraphs.zh: 组件维度保留了视觉基准和动作–组件因果关系，而无需单独的完整性分数：

paragraphs.en: Unlike the driving action-match gate, navigation safety gates the entire score:
paragraphs.zh: 与驾驶动作匹配门不同，导航安全门会对整个分数进行限制：

paragraphs.en: Thus, unsafe movements receive zero overall credit, while safe movements are distinguished by goal progress and grounded justification. For instructions involving manipulation, the rubric evaluates navigation to the target rather than completion of the manipulation itself.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，不安全的移动获得的总评分为零，而安全的移动则通过目标进展和实际依据来区分。对于涉及操作的指令，评分标准评估的是到达目标的导航过程，而非操作本身的完成度。

paragraphs.en: This task-specific aggregation reflects different reasoning demands. Driving decisions often hinge on a few critical scene elements, such as an emerging pedestrian or a red light. We therefore explicitly score component completeness and retain credit for correctly grounded and causally relevant observations even when the proposed action is unsafe, distinguishing preserved scene understanding from failures in action selection. In robot navigation, before the target is localized, selecting a productive exploration direction is more central than comprehensive component coverage. We therefore emphasize goal consistency, retain grounding and causation without a separate completeness term, and treat action safety as a prerequisite for overall credit.
paragraphs.zh: 这种针对特定任务的聚合方式反映了不同的推理需求。驾驶决策通常取决于几个关键场景要素，例如突然出现的行人或红灯。因此，我们明确对组件的完整性进行评分，并在所提议的动作不安全时，仍保留对正确定位且具有因果相关性的观察结果的认可，从而将保留的场景理解与动作选择中的失误区分开来。在机器人导航中，在定位目标之前，选择一个富有成效的探索方向比全面覆盖所有组件更为关键。因此，我们强调目标一致性，在没有单独完整性指标的情况下保留定位和因果关系，并将动作安全性视为获得整体认可的前提条件。

paragraphs.en: Coactive Calibration. The initial rubric specifies the evaluation dimensions, their scoring criteria, common critical components, action priorities, and rules for handling noisy. When progress plateaus, human experts inspect the remaining disagreements together with the teacher’s diagnostic scores and explanations. They may correct an individual dimension, identify missing physical evidence, or clarify an underspecified criterion. These clarifications are incorporated into the next rubric revision. Each revision is evaluated on both newly queried cases and cases retained from earlier iterations. We accept a revision only when it improves human alignment on the current batch without causing a substantial regression on previously calibrated cases.
paragraphs.zh: 协同校准。初始评分标准规定了评估维度、其评分准则、常见的关键要素、行动优先级以及处理噪声数据的规则。当进展陷入停滞时，人类专家会与教师一起检查剩余的争议点，并结合教师的诊断分数和解释进行分析。他们可能会修正某个具体维度，识别缺失的物理证据，或澄清某个表述不够明确的准则。这些澄清内容将被纳入下一版评分标准的修订中。每一版修订都会在新查询的案例以及从早期迭代中保留的案例上进行评估。只有当修订版本在提升当前批次案例与人类判断的一致性时，并未导致先前已校准案例出现显著倒退，我们才会接受该修订版本。

paragraphs.en: Although the teacher provides strong, structured evaluations, querying a frontier VLM throughout policy optimization is computationally expensive, with long latency and high API cost, especially for the reinforcement fine-tuning of the driving reasoning task based on GRPO with high query frequency. We therefore distill its evaluation capability into a compact student judge. The student receives the same physical context, driving instruction, and candidate output as the teacher and predicts all the rubric dimensions in a single forward pass.

paragraphs.en: We construct two complementary, expert-verified evaluation and testing resources with distinct purposes. The fixed policy evaluation set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} tracks policy progress and supports verification-boundary detection, whereas the cumulative judge evaluation set 𝒥 t \mathcal{J}_{t} supports human calibration and judge refinement. Because large-scale driving data inevitably contain noisy or erroneous samples, human experts inspect and verify the camera observations, trajectories, reasoning annotations, and reasoning scores of every evaluation sample.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了两套互补且经过专家验证的评估与测试资源，二者具有不同的用途。固定策略评估集 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 用于追踪策略进展，并支持验证边界检测；而累积判断评估集 𝒥 t \mathcal{J}_{t} 则支持人类校准与判断优化。由于大规模驾驶数据中不可避免地存在噪声或错误样本，因此人类专家会对每个评估样本的摄像头观测结果、轨迹、推理标注及推理分数进行审查与验证。

paragraphs.en: Notably, the final policy and judge performance are evaluated on the independent corresponding test sets 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} and 𝒥 t test \mathcal{J}_{t}^{\mathrm{test}} with the same distribution as the evaluation sets. The Table 4 summarizes the details of those sets, and the Figure 8 shows the distribution of the larger test set.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，最终策略和评判器的性能是在与评估集具有相同分布的独立对应测试集 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} 和 𝒥 t test \mathcal{J}_{t}^{\mathrm{test}} 上进行评估的。表 4 总结了这些测试集的详细信息，而图 8 展示了较大测试集的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Policy Evaluation and Testing Set of Driving Reasoning The policy evaluation and testing sets 𝒫 \mathcal{P} & 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} come from carefully selected driving scenarios. Human experts inspect each scenario and correct unreliable reasoning annotations. The resulting set covers diverse geographic regions, e.g., the U.S., Europe, the U.K., and South Korea, as well as varied road structures, weather conditions, and lighting conditions. It contains both reasoning-dense scenarios involving multiple interacting agents and reasoning-light scenarios with the straightforward decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶推理的政策评估与测试集 政策评估与测试集 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 和 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} 来自经过精心选择的驾驶场景。人类专家会检查每个场景，并修正不可靠的推理标注。由此形成的数据集涵盖了多样的地理区域（例如美国、欧洲、英国和韩国），以及不同的道路结构、天气条件和光照条件。该数据集既包含涉及多个相互作用的智能体的推理密集型场景，也包含决策较为简单的推理轻量型场景。

paragraphs.en: Because the reward judge evolves throughout self-improvement, its scores cannot provide a fixed basis for comparing policies across iterations. Human experts curate policy evaluation sets to maintain diversity across scenario categories and reasoning densities, providing a stable evaluation anchor for the complete self-improvement process. Figure 8 summarizes the distribution of 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} across geographic regions, scenario categories, and reasoning-density levels.
paragraphs.zh: 由于奖励评判器在自我提升过程中会持续演变，其评分无法为跨迭代策略的比较提供固定的基准。人类专家通过构建策略评估集来维持不同场景类别和推理密度之间的多样性，从而为整个自我提升过程提供稳定的评估锚点。图 8 总结了 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} 在不同地理区域、场景类别和推理密度水平上的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Judge Evaluation and Testing Set of Driving Reasoning At judge-improvement iteration t t , an incremental set ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} & ℋ t test \mathcal{H}_{t}^{\mathrm{test}} is constructed from outputs generated by the latest policy. As summarized in Table 4 , the first batch contains broadly sampled cases generated by the initial policy and is used to establish the initial human–judge calibration. The second batch contains challenging cases generated after policy improvement. These cases emphasize newly exposed policy failures, judge–human disagreements, and outputs near the judge’s effective verification boundary. Unlike policy training data, 𝒥 t \mathcal{J}_{t} deliberately retains both high- and low-quality outputs. Negative cases are necessary for identifying false positives, refining rubric boundaries, and detecting reward-hacking behavior during judge model training.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶推理的法官评估与测试集 在法官改进迭代 t 时，从最新策略生成的输出中构建一个增量集合 ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} 和一个测试集合 ℋ t^{\mathrm{test}} \mathcal{H}_{t}^{\mathrm{test}}。如表 4 所示，第一批包含由初始策略广泛采样生成的案例，用于建立最初的人类–法官校准。第二批包含策略改进后生成的具有挑战性的案例。这些案例重点关注新暴露的策略失败、法官与人类之间的分歧，以及接近法官有效验证边界的输出。与策略训练数据不同，𝒥 t \mathcal{J}_{t} 会刻意保留高质量和低质量的输出。负样本对于识别假阳性、完善评分标准边界以及在法官模型训练过程中检测奖励欺骗行为是必要的。

paragraphs.en: VLNVerse ( 29 ) provides interactive indoor environments and navigation episodes pairing language instructions with reference trajectories, including both fine-grained route-following and coarse-grained goal-directed tasks. These episode-level annotations do not directly provide the observation-aligned, decision-level reasoning supervision. We therefore collect robot-view observations and construct reasoning examples that connect a destination goal and local visual evidence to the next navigation decision. The target is to determine where to explore, how to approach the target, and when to stop, without receiving intermediate route instructions.
paragraphs.zh: VLNVerse (29) 提供了交互式室内环境和导航任务，将语言指令与参考轨迹相结合，既包括精细的路径跟随任务，也包括粗粒度的目标导向任务。这些任务级别的标注并未直接提供与观察结果对齐的、决策层面的推理监督。因此，我们收集了机器人视角的观察数据，并构建了推理示例，将目的地目标和局部视觉证据与下一个导航决策联系起来。其目标是确定探索方向、接近目标的方式以及停止时机，而无需接收中间的路径指令。

paragraphs.en: We collect egocentric image sequences along navigation trajectories in VLNVerse scenes. Given the original navigation instruction and sampled frames in the trajectory, Claude Opus 5 ( 2 ) segments each trajectory into consecutive turning, traversal, doorway, approach, and arrival intervals and generates a concise, landmark-grounded movement description for each interval.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 VLNVerse 场景的导航轨迹上收集以自我为中心的图片序列。根据原始导航指令和轨迹中采样的帧，Claude Opus 5 ( 2 ) 将每条轨迹分割为连续的转向、穿行、过门、接近和到达阶段，并为每个阶段生成一个简洁且基于地标点的移动描述。

paragraphs.en: At each interval’s starting point, we pair the generated annotation with the current observation, two historical observations, and a destination instruction derived from the original task by retaining the final goal and removing intermediate route commands. This produces 19k samples with resolved destination instructions. The resulting pool supports judge-guided selection of reasoning supervision for policy improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个时间间隔的起点，我们将生成的标注与当前观察结果、两个历史观察结果以及一个源自原始任务的目的地指令进行配对；该目的地指令通过保留最终目标并移除中间路线指令而生成。由此产生了19,000个样本，其中目的地指令均已明确。最终的样本池支持在策略改进过程中，由裁判引导地选择推理监督方案。

paragraphs.en: Policy Evaluation Set of Robot Navigation Reasoning
paragraphs.zh: 机器人导航推理策略评估集

paragraphs.en: The fixed policy evaluation set and independent policy test set contain 182 and 220 samples, respectively, from 46 episodes across 28 scenes. The distribution of the larger policy test set is 53 turning, 69 traversal, 36 doorway, 36 approach, and 26 arrival decisions. All the samples in the policy set have been verified to ensure the quality of the decision time and reasoning content.
paragraphs.zh: 固定策略评估集和独立策略测试集分别包含 182 个和 220 个样本，这些样本来自 28 个场景中的 46 个回合。较大的策略测试集的分布为：53 个转向决策、69 个穿行决策、36 个门洞决策、36 个接近决策以及 26 个到达决策。策略集中的所有样本均已经过验证，以确保决策时间和推理内容的质量。

paragraphs.en: Judge Evaluation Set of Robot Navigation Reasoning We initially construct a candidate pool by pairing source reasoning annotations with VLM-generated negative candidates. These candidates introduce controlled errors in the proposed movement or referenced scene elements while preserving the instruction and observations. Human review determines their rubric scores and yields an initial judge evaluation and independent test sets of 175 and 211 candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人导航推理的评估集构建：我们首先通过将源推理标注与VLM生成的负样本候选项配对，构建一个候选池。这些候选项在保留指令和观察结果的同时，对提议的移动方式或引用的场景元素引入了受控错误。通过人工评审确定其评分标准得分，并由此生成包含175个和211个候选项的初始评估集与独立测试集。

paragraphs.en: Subsequent policy rollouts reveal weaknesses in exploration efficiency, particularly in selecting productive directions and deciding whether to approach, stop, or continue searching. Guided by these observed failure patterns, the agent constructs 107 additional contrast candidates, targeting distinctions between superficially plausible actions and movements that actually advance the navigation goal. The expanded judge evaluation and test set contain 212 and 281 candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 后续的策略展开揭示了探索效率方面的弱点，尤其是在选择有效方向以及决定是接近、停止还是继续搜索方面。基于这些观察到的失败模式，该智能体构建了 107 个额外的对比候选项，旨在区分表面看似合理的动作与真正能够推进导航目标的动作。扩展后的评判评估集和测试集分别包含 212 个和 281 个候选项。

paragraphs.en: Because the reference-free judge evolves across iterations, we use a fixed reference-based judge J ref J^{\mathrm{ref}} to test the policy progress on 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} , which compares each policy-generated reasoning with its expert-verified reference reasoning. VeriFine-Judge-RB remains fixed during development monitoring and final policy evaluation. Its use as a reward model is confined to the reference-based baselines explicitly identified in Table 1 . The evolving reference-free judge supplies the training reward for VeriFine policies.
paragraphs.zh: 由于无参考评判器在迭代过程中会不断演化，我们使用一个固定的基于参考的评判器 J ref J^{\mathrm{ref}} 来测试策略在 𝒫 test \mathcal{P}^{\mathrm{test}} 上的进展，该评判器会将每个策略生成的推理过程与其由专家验证的参考推理进行比较。在开发监控和最终策略评估期间，VeriFine-Judge-RB 始终保持不变。其作为奖励模型的使用仅限于表 1 中明确列出的基于参考的基线模型。而不断演化的无参考评判器则为 VeriFine 策略提供训练奖励。

paragraphs.en: The VeriFine-Judge-RB is a DeBERTa-v3-base cross-encoder ( 16 ) initialized from Lingo-Judge ( 35 ) . It takes a fixed question, the reference reasoning, and the candidate reasoning as input, and produces a scalar score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] through a single classification head. VeriFine-Judge-RB is further fine-tuned on approximately 500K reference–candidate pairs using binary cross-entropy.
paragraphs.zh: VeriFine-Judge-RB 是一个 DeBERTa-v3-base 交叉编码器（16），其初始化基于 Lingo-Judge（35）。它以固定的问题、参考推理和候选推理作为输入，并通过单个分类头输出一个位于 [0, 1] 范围内的标量分数。VeriFine-Judge-RB 还在约 50 万对参考–候选数据上通过二元交叉熵进行了进一步微调。

paragraphs.en: We also leverage the rubric across action and critical components for the teacher model to obtain large-scale reasoning annotations to train the VeriFine-Judge-RB model. We leverage Claude Opus, GPT, and Gemini to annotate the reasoning score individually based on the rubric, and average them as the training supervision data for the VeriFine-Judge-RB model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还利用该评分标准对教师模型的动作和关键组成部分进行标注，以获得大规模推理标注数据，用于训练 VeriFine-Judge-RB 模型。我们分别使用 Claude Opus、GPT 和 Gemini 根据该评分标准对推理分数进行标注，并将这些分数取平均值作为 VeriFine-Judge-RB 模型的训练监督数据。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning Score. For each sample, the evaluation protocol assigns a reasoning score s i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s_{i}\in[0,1] : the reference-based judge uses expert reference reasoning, the reference-free judge uses the observed context and rubric. We report the mean scaled by 100.
paragraphs.zh: 推理得分。对于每个样本，评估协议会分配一个推理得分 s i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s_{i}\in[0,1]：基于参考的评判者使用专家提供的参考推理，而无需参考的评判者则使用观察到的上下文和评分标准。我们报告的是将结果乘以 100 后的平均值。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement Fine-tuning for Driving Policy. In the driving reasoning task, we initialize the Alpamayo 1.5 8B policy and optimize it with reinforcement fine-tuning with GRPO, using VeriFine-Judge both to provide the online reward and to adaptively construct the training curriculum. The selected training set with curriculum judge contains the fixed 25K samples from a pool of 400K candidates, and the training data budget is fixed for fair comparison. Each update uses 32 prompts with K = 16 K=16 rollouts per prompt, resulting in an effective batch size of 512 rollouts. We train for fixed 2,700 steps using AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} and a KL coefficient of 0.02 0.02 , on 20 NVIDIA H100 GPU nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶策略的强化微调。在驾驶推理任务中，我们首先初始化 Alpamayo 1.5 8B 智能体策略，然后利用 GRPO 方法对其进行强化微调，同时借助 VeriFine-Judge 提供在线奖励并自适应地构建训练课程。通过课程选择器筛选出的训练集包含从 40 万个候选样本中固定的 2.5 万个样本，为保持公平比较，训练数据预算也保持固定。每次更新使用 32 个提示，每个提示执行 K = 16 K=16 次 rollout，因此有效批量大小为 512 次 rollout。我们在 20 台 NVIDIA H100 GPU 节点上，使用 AdamW 优化器进行固定 2,700 步的训练，学习率设为 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5}，KL 系数设为 0.02 0.02。

paragraphs.en: Supervised Fine-tuning for Robot Navigation Policy. For the robot navigation reasoning task, the policy is initialized from the Qwen3-VL 2B base model. All runs use 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs and a global batch size of 128. We freeze the vision backbone while updating the language model and visual merger with AdamW, using learning rates of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and 10 − 6 10^{-6} , respectively, and weight decay of 0.01 0.01 . Moreover, the SFT uses cosine learning-rate decay.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人导航策略的监督微调。对于机器人导航推理任务，策略基于 Qwen3-VL 2B 基础模型进行初始化。所有运行均使用 8 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 和 128 的全局批量大小。我们在更新语言模型和视觉合并器时冻结视觉主干网络，并使用 AdamW 优化器，学习率分别为 10^{-5} 和 10^{-6}，权重衰减为 0.01。此外，SFT 采用余弦学习率衰减策略。

paragraphs.en: Student VeriFine-Judge Training. We freeze its vision backbone and train the language backbone and a five-way classification head on 35K teacher-labeled examples using equal-weight binary cross-entropy, with 0.1 0.1 label smoothing applied only to the action-matching output. We train it on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with a global batch size of 16, using AdamW with learning rates of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the backbone and classification head, respectively. We use 500 warmup steps followed by cosine decay to 0.2 × 0.2\times the peak learning rate, weight decay of 0.1 0.1 , and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 .
paragraphs.zh: 学生 VeriFine-Judge 训练。我们冻结其视觉主干网络，并在 35K 条教师标注的示例上，使用等权二元交叉熵损失函数，对语言主干网络和五分类头进行训练，其中仅对动作匹配输出应用 0.1 的标签平滑。我们在 8 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上进行训练，全局批量大小为 16，并使用 AdamW 优化器，主干网络和分类头的学习率分别为 4 × 10⁻⁵ 和 10⁻³。我们采用 500 个预热步数，随后以余弦衰减方式将学习率降至峰值学习率的 0.2 倍，设置权重衰减为 0.1，并将梯度裁剪值设为 1.0。

paragraphs.en: VeriFine-Judge-RB Training. We train our reference-based model on approximately 500K reference–candidate reasoning pairs with 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, using binary cross-entropy with rubric-derived soft targets and a maximum sequence length of 256. We use fused AdamW with a global batch size of 128, a learning rate of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.01 0.01 , 250 warmup steps, cosine decay to 1 % 1\% of the peak learning rate, and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 .
paragraphs.zh: VeriFine-Judge-RB 训练。我们使用 16 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU，在约 50 万个参考–候选推理对上训练我们的参考基模型，采用基于评分标准的软目标进行二元交叉熵损失计算，最大序列长度为 256。我们使用融合 AdamW 优化器，全局批量大小为 128，学习率为 4 × 10⁻⁵，权重衰减为 0.01，设置 250 个预热步数，采用余弦退火将学习率降至峰值的 1%，并将梯度裁剪值设为 1.0。

paragraphs.en: Judge Improvement Loop Trigger. Boundary checks are performed every 150 steps on the policy evaluation set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} during policy training. P t P_{t} is measured by the fixed VeriFine-Judge-RB evaluator. The progress signals use the reasoning score, with Δ ​ R t judge \Delta R_{t}^{\mathrm{judge}} computed using the current judge, which is used as the reward judge. We use a window of K = 4 K=4 and a 0.5 threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 改进循环触发器。在策略训练期间，每 150 步对策略评估集 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 执行边界检查。P t P_{t} 由固定的 VeriFine-Judge-RB 评估器进行测量。进展信号使用推理分数，其中 Δ ​ R t judge \Delta R_{t}^{\mathrm{judge}} 使用当前的评判者计算，该评判者也用作奖励评判者。我们使用 K = 4 K=4 的窗口和 0.5 的阈值。

paragraphs.en: Curriculum Selection. The executed selection rule is a ranking rule based on target-quality, learnability, and category type, with a tie-breaking rule, yielding 25K examples from the 400K candidate pool for driving. For navigation, context priority is determined by a failure-based selection rule, while demonstration quality is checked using the target-quality criterion. We retain 13K examples per round. Selection rules are updated from failures observed on 𝒫 \mathcal{P} .
paragraphs.zh: 课程选择。实际执行的选择规则是一种基于目标质量、可学习性和类别类型的排序规则，并辅以平局决胜规则，从而从 40 万个候选池中选出 2.5 万个示例用于驱动。对于导航部分，上下文优先级由基于失败的选择规则确定，而演示质量则通过目标质量标准进行检验。我们每轮保留 1.3 万个示例。选择规则会根据在 𝒫 \mathcal{P} 上观察到的失败情况进行更新。

paragraphs.en: Rubric Revision. The agent modifies sub-rubric details and demonstration examples while keeping the rubric dimensions unchanged. Each proposal is evaluated on the current calibration batch and retained calibration cases. Revisions are accepted according to Pearson correlation and MAE performance. Each round permits 20 version rubrics, and human review is requested when the average improvement in Pearson correlation is less than 0.2 for more than ten iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 评分标准修订。智能体在保持评分标准维度不变的同时，修改子评分标准的细节和演示示例。每个提案均基于当前的校准批次和保留的校准案例进行评估。修订是否被接受取决于皮尔逊相关系数和MAE的表现。每轮允许使用20个版本评分标准；若超过十次迭代后，皮尔逊相关系数的平均提升值仍小于0.2，则需请求人工审核。

paragraphs.en: Human Calibration and Test Annotation During coactive calibration, human annotators and the agent resolve rubric ambiguities through evidence-based discussion, allowing both the rubric and human calibration scores to be revised. Then, we trained another set of annotators and independently scored the judge test set without access to judge scores. Test labels are subsequently frozen and used consistently across all iteration rounds and judge comparisons, without informing rubric refinement or model selection.
paragraphs.zh: 在协同校准过程中，人类标注员与智能体通过基于证据的讨论解决评分标准的模糊之处，从而使得评分标准以及人类的校准分数都可以得到修订。随后，我们训练了另一组标注员，并在无法查看裁判分数的情况下，独立对裁判测试集进行评分。之后，测试标签将被固定下来，并在所有迭代轮次和裁判对比中保持一致使用，而不会用于指导评分标准的优化或模型的选择。

paragraphs.en: While the judge evaluation set evolves with the policy to capture newly exposed failure patterns, the current framework retains a fixed policy evaluation set as a consistent anchor for measuring improvement across iterations. Future work could preserve a fixed held-out test set for comparable reporting while introducing an adaptive policy evaluation set that co-evolves with the policy and judge to provide increasingly informative signals for failure discovery and curriculum construction. The framework also still relies on reasoning-annotated data: although the reference-free VeriFine-Judge can filter low-quality reasoning during training, the reference reasoning used for policy evaluation remains human-verified. A natural extension is therefore to jointly evolve a reasoning annotator that generates and refines reference reasoning using structured judge feedback. Finally, while coactive calibration already consolidates human expertise into the evolving rubric and reduces repeated queries, explicitly distilling human corrections, instructions, and rubric revisions into a reusable guidance model could further reduce human involvement and eventually enable continued judge improvement without routine human guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管法官评估集会随着策略的演变而更新，以捕捉新出现的失败模式，但当前框架仍保留一个固定的策略评估集，作为衡量各迭代阶段改进情况的一致性基准。未来的工作可以在保持一个固定的预留测试集以确保报告结果具有可比性的同时，引入一个与策略和法官共同演化的自适应策略评估集，从而为失败检测和课程构建提供信息量日益丰富的信号。此外，该框架仍然依赖带有推理标注的数据：尽管无需参考的 VeriFine-Judge 能够在训练过程中过滤低质量的推理，但用于策略评估的参考推理仍需经过人工验证。因此，一个自然的扩展方向是共同演化一种推理标注器，使其能够利用结构化的法官反馈来生成和精炼参考推理。最后，虽然协同校准机制已经将人类专业知识整合到不断演变的评分标准中，并减少了重复查询，但如果能将人类的修正、指令和评分标准的修订明确提炼为一个可重用的指导模型，将进一步降低人工干预的程度，并最终实现无需持续人工指导即可不断推进法官能力的提升。
